edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall purchase from the Seller [ISSUER, CLASS AND NUMBER OF SHARES TO BE IDENTIFIED] (the Shares) for [PURCHASE PRICE AND CURRENCY TO BE AGREED]. Subject to agreement of those particulars and client approval, the purchase price shall be paid in full at Closing in cleared funds to an account designated in writing by the Seller through independently verified payment instructions. There shall be no deferred consideration or purchase-price adjustment.

2. CLOSING. The parties shall target Closing within thirty days after signing, subject to satisfaction or lawful waiver by the party entitled to its benefit of the approvals, closing conditions and deliverables expressly specified in [AGREED CLOSING SCHEDULE]. Closing shall involve simultaneous payment of the purchase price and delivery of duly executed share-transfer instruments and other agreed deliverables. The long-stop date shall be [DATE TO BE AGREED]. If Closing has not occurred by that date, either party may terminate by written notice, except a party whose breach caused the failure to close. Termination shall not affect accrued rights or liability for prior breach. No approvals, conditions, deliverables or long-stop date are agreed merely by inclusion of this clause.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents that the financial statements identified in [SCHEDULE TO BE AGREED] have been prepared in accordance with [ACCOUNTING STANDARDS TO BE AGREED], consistently applied except as expressly identified in their notes, and fairly present in all material respects the financial position and results of operations of [RELEVANT ENTITY] as of and for the periods identified therein, subject to matters fairly disclosed with sufficient detail to identify their nature and scope in [AGREED DISCLOSURE SCHEDULE]. Any qualifications relating to interim statements shall be expressly agreed.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations expressly agreed below, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against actual losses arising from liabilities of [RELEVANT ENTITY] existing at Closing that were required by [AGREED ACCOUNTING STANDARDS] to be recorded or provided for in [IDENTIFIED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS], but were neither so recorded or provided for nor fairly disclosed with sufficient detail to identify their nature and scope in [AGREED DISCLOSURE SCHEDULE]. Recovery shall exclude losses to the extent caused by the Buyer and shall be subject to [AGREED CAP], [AGREED BASKET AND WHETHER DEDUCTIBLE OR TIPPING] and [AGREED SURVIVAL PERIOD AND CLAIM-NOTICE REQUIREMENTS]. The Buyer shall give reasonably prompt notice of third-party claims; delay shall reduce recovery only to the extent it materially prejudices the defense. The Seller may control the defense using reasonably acceptable counsel, subject to agreed protections for conflicts of interest and non-monetary relief, and the Buyer may participate at its own expense. No settlement may impose an admission, payment obligation or non-monetary obligation on the Buyer without its prior written consent. There shall be no double recovery for the same loss, including amounts actually recovered under insurance or from third parties, net of reasonable recovery costs. The bracketed limitations and detailed claims procedure remain subject to express agreement.
Please confirm the Seller's full legal name and the issuer, class and number of Shares. Identity and transaction particulars remain unconfirmed.
Please propose the cap, basket structure, survival period and claims procedure. These provisions are negotiation placeholders, not acceptance of unspecified limitations.

receiver.message_back: Subject to client approval and verification of the outstanding transaction particulars, Buyer proposes a long-stop date 60 days after signing, with closing conditional on required regulatory and third-party approvals, evidence of Seller’s title and authority, release of share encumbrances, executed transfers and delivery of share certificates or equivalent ownership records. For the undisclosed-liabilities indemnity, we propose a cap equal to the purchase price, a 0.5% tipping basket and 24-month survival, with timely notified claims surviving until resolved, no limitation for fraud, and Seller’s control of third-party claims conditional on acknowledging coverage and protections for conflicts and non-monetary relief; all other unresolved terms remain reserved.
